title_sq: VILE PER SHITJE NE LIQENIN E FARKES
description_sq:
Prona ndodhet ne nje nga rezidencat me te reja prane liqenit te Farkes. Kompleksi perbehet nga 14 vila dhe nje godine te organizuar ne apartamente premium. 
Vila organizohet ne 3 kate 
- Kati -1 ka nje siperfaqe prej 58.7 m2 dhe sherben si vend parkimi per dy automjete dhe depo,
- Kati 0 ka nje siperfaqe prej 101.8 m2 dhe organizohet ne ambient ndenje, ambient gatimi dhe nje tualet,
- Kati 1 ka nje siperfaqe prej 122.3 dhe organizohet ne tre dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe ballkon perimetrik qe aksesohet nga te gjitha dhomat. 
Siperfaqja e parceles eshte 273m2 ku te jep mundesine edhe te ndertimit te pishines. 
Vilat jane ne fazen perfudimtrare ku aktuasht po punohet me rifiniturat dhe rregullimin e ambienteve te perbashketa. 
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni.
title_en: VILLA FOR SALE IN FARKA LAKE
description_en: The property is located in one of the newest residences near the Farka lake. The complex consists of 14 villas and a building organized into premium apartments. The villa is organized in 3 floors - Floor -1 has an area of ​​58.7 m2 and serves as a parking space for two vehicles and storage, - Floor 0 has an area of ​​101.8 m2 and is organized in a living room, kitchen area and a toilet, - Floor 1 has an area of ​​122.3 and is organized in three bedrooms, two toilets and a perimeter balcony that is accessed from all rooms. The surface of the plot is 273 m2, which gives the possibility of building a swimming pool. The villas are in the final stage where they are currently working on refinishing and arranging the common areas. For more information, contact us.
